title: Rule file
description: One file of a rule pack (national, or state/<STATE>.yaml): a list of rules. Every rule has an id, a tier, a kind and a citation; anything else on a rule is a parameter of its kind (value_mm, applies_to, zone...). See documents/electrical-engine-plan.md §6.9.

id.description: Unique in the pack: area, then what it governs, dot-separated (wet.gpo.zone2).

tier.description: mandatory: the Wiring Rules, NCC, state law (a violation is an error). regulatory: state variations and distributor rules, only in state files. policy: good practice and company preference (a violation is a warning; companies may change the values).

kind.description: How the engine evaluates the rule (§6.9).

cite.description: Where the value comes from: a clause number, or 'Company standard'. Never the standard's text.

message.description: What a violation says to the user.

verified.description: Checked against the licensed standard (false: a working assumption, the plan's ⚠). Defaults to false.

override.description: State files only: this rule replaces the national rule with the same id.
